series.title_en: Chinese Classics: Four Beauties and Three Kingdoms
series.description_en: Legends of the Four Beauties of ancient China and key episodes from the novel Romance of the Three Kingdoms.
Professor Lin collects ideas about the end of time and the world to come from different peoples and religions.
Scientists, athletes and artists talk in the first person about the school subjects they excelled at.
A tea master's apprentice travels across China and learns the secrets of its most famous teas.
A young apprentice learns traditional Chinese medicine and healing cooking from an experienced doctor.

series.title_en: Dream of the Red Chamber, Retold
series.description_en: The classic novel Dream of the Red Chamber in simple modern Chinese: love, poetry and the decline of a great family.

series.title_en: Stories Behind Great Poems and Songs
series.description_en: The lives and legends behind China's most famous poems and songs, from Li Bai to the present day.
Lively stories about today's youth slang and internet words (996, 内卷, 躺平, yyds, 破防了, emo了, 润学 and more), set in everyday office, campus and social-media situations.
Original stories in the spirit of Chinese science fiction: space, AI and the future of humanity.
Original stories about village life and change in modern China, in the spirit of Mo Yan and his contemporaries.

series.title_en: Chinese Humor: Jokes and Tall Tales
series.description_en: A collection of funny stories, jokes and odd incidents from everyday life in modern China.
People in all kinds of jobs, from pilot to baker, talk about their work and the words they need.

series.title_en: Chinese History: From Ancient Times to Today
series.description_en: Key events and eras of Chinese history in plain language, from the first dynasties to the present.
The stories of China's biggest companies and the people who built them.
Scientists, athletes, artists and others who made China famous.
A tour of China's most beautiful and famous places for future travelers.
Stories of ports in China and of ports abroad linked to Chinese companies and investment.
Bridges, dams, skyscrapers and other engineering feats of modern China.
Stories about illness, treatment and medicine: useful vocabulary for a visit to the doctor or the pharmacy.
From computers and microchips to major engineering projects: stories from the world of technology.

series.title_en: In the Courtroom: Stories and Legal Vocabulary
series.description_en: Short fictional stories set in the courtroom that introduce legal vocabulary.
Stories and debates about how artificial intelligence is changing people's lives.
About the most popular and best-loved Chinese TV dramas across many genres.
Stories of famous Chinese singers and their biggest hits (without quoting song lyrics).
Stories and ideas from psychology, explained simply through everyday situations.

series.title_en: Visions of the Future Across Cultures
series.description_en: How different cultures and eras imagined the future, from ancient legends to modern technology.
Stories about rare and surprising jobs from around the world, from professional line-sitter to whistler.
The stories and recipes behind twenty of the most famous dishes in Chinese cuisine.
The stories of famous Chinese restaurants, teahouses and street-food stalls, from century-old shops to modern fusion cafés.

series.title_en: Good News from Around the World
series.description_en: Uplifting news from around the world: discoveries, records and people making the world a better place.
Traditional and modern 字谜: riddles built on the shape and sound of characters, with an explanation of how each one works.
Short, funny stories about everyday mix-ups, coincidences and happy accidents in the lives of ordinary people in modern China.
